leadText: Eri Kitamura (Japanese: 喜多村英梨 Kitamura Eri) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Eri Kitamura (Japanese: 喜多村英梨 Kitamura Eri) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Kitamura was born on August 16, 1987, in , , and became a voice actress and singer as a teenager. She was affiliated with the talent agency Early Wing. Kitamura provided her voice for the Virbank City Gym Leader Roxie in , as well as the Rustboro City Gym Leader Roxanne in the Pokémon Omega Ruby and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Animated Trailer. In addition to voice acting and singing, Kitamura is an amateur manga artist.
